name: The Good News According to Mark

verses.text: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.
He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,
“\+w Listen \+w Behold \+w the farmer \+w went \+w out \+w to \+w sow *
\+w As \+w he \+w sowed \+w some \+w seed \+w fell \+w by \+w the \+w road \+w and \+w the \+w birds \+w came \+w and \+w devoured \+w it *

\+w Others \+w fell \+w on \+w the \+w rocky \+w ground \+w where \+w it \+w had little \+w soil \+w and \+w immediately \+w it \+w sprang \+w up \+w because \+w it \+w had \+w no depth \+w of \+w soil *
\+w When \+w the \+w sun \+w had \+w risen \+w it \+w was \+w scorched \+w and \+w because \+w it \+w had \+w no \+w root \+w it \+w withered \+w away *
\+w Others \+w fell \+w among \+w the thorns, \+w and \+w the thorns grew \+w up \+w and \+w choked \+w it \+w and \+w it \+w yielded \+w no \+w fruit *

\+w Others \+w fell \+w into \+w the \+w good \+w ground \+w and \+w yielded \+w fruit growing \+w up \+w and increasing. \+w Some \+w produced \+w thirty times, \+w some \+w sixty times, \+w and \+w some \+w one \+w hundred times \+w as much.”*
He said, “\+w Whoever \+w has \+w ears \+w to hear, \+w let \+w him hear.”*
When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

He said to them, “\+w To \+w you \+w is \+w given \+w the \+w mystery \+w of \+w God Kingdom, \+w but \+w to \+w those \+w who \+w are \+w outside \+w all \+w things \+w are \+w done \+w in \+w parables *

\+w that ‘\+w seeing \+w they \+w may \+w see \+w and \+w not \+w perceive \+w and hearing \+w they \+w may hear \+w and \+w not \+w understand \+w lest \+w perhaps \+w they \+w should \+w turn \+w again \+w and \+w their sins \+w should \+w be forgiven \+w them
He said to them, “Don’\+w t \+w you \+w understand \+w this \+w parable \+w How \+w will \+w you \+w understand \+w all \+w of \+w the \+w parables *
\+w The farmer \+w sows \+w the \+w word *

\+w The ones \+w by \+w the \+w road \+w are \+w the ones \+w where \+w the \+w word \+w is \+w sown \+w and \+w when \+w they \+w have heard, \+w immediately \+w Satan \+w comes \+w and takes away \+w the \+w word \+w which \+w has \+w been \+w sown \+w in \+w them *

\+w These \+w in \+w the \+w same \+w way \+w are \+w those \+w who \+w are \+w sown \+w on \+w the \+w rocky places, \+w who \+w when \+w they \+w have heard \+w the \+w word \+w immediately \+w receive \+w it \+w with \+w joy *

\+w They \+w have \+w no \+w root \+w in \+w themselves \+w but \+w are short-lived. \+w When oppression \+w or \+w persecution \+w arises \+w because \+w of \+w the \+w word \+w immediately \+w they \+w stumble *
\+w Others \+w are \+w those \+w who \+w are \+w sown \+w among \+w the thorns. \+w These \+w are \+w those \+w who \+w have heard \+w the \+w word *

\+w and \+w the \+w cares \+w of \+w this age, \+w and \+w the deceitfulness \+w of \+w riches \+w and \+w the \+w lusts \+w of \+w other \+w things \+w entering \+w in \+w choke \+w the \+w word \+w and \+w it \+w becomes unfruitful. *

\+w Those \+w which \+w were \+w sown \+w on \+w the \+w good \+w ground \+w are \+w those \+w who hear \+w the \+w word \+w accept \+w it \+w and \+w bear \+w fruit \+w some \+w thirty times, \+w some \+w sixty times, \+w and \+w some \+w one \+w hundred times.”*
He said to them, “\+w Is \+w a \+w lamp \+w brought \+w to \+w be \+w put \+w under \+w a \+w basket * \+w or \+w under \+w a \+w bed Isn’\+w t \+w it \+w put \+w on \+w a stand? *

\+w For \+w there \+w is \+w nothing \+w hidden \+w except \+w that \+w it \+w should \+w be \+w made \+w known \+w neither \+w was \+w anything \+w made \+w secret \+w but \+w that \+w it \+w should \+w come \+w to \+w light *
\+w If \+w any \+w man \+w has \+w ears \+w to hear, \+w let him hear.”*

He said to them, “\+w Take heed \+w what \+w you \+w hear \+w With \+w whatever \+w measure \+w you \+w measure \+w it \+w will \+w be \+w measured \+w to \+w you \+w and \+w more \+w will \+w be \+w given \+w to \+w you \+w who \+w hear *

\+w For \+w whoever \+w has \+w to \+w him \+w more \+w will \+w be \+w given \+w and \+w he \+w who doesn’t \+w have \+w even \+w that \+w which \+w he \+w has \+w will \+w be taken away \+w from \+w him
He said, “\+w God Kingdom \+w is \+w as \+w if \+w a \+w man \+w should \+w cast \+w seed \+w on \+w the \+w earth *
\+w and \+w should \+w sleep \+w and \+w rise \+w night \+w and \+w day \+w and \+w the \+w seed \+w should spring \+w up \+w and grow, \+w though \+w he doesn’\+w t \+w know \+w how *
\+w For \+w the \+w earth \+w bears \+w fruit \+w by itself: \+w first \+w the \+w blade \+w then \+w the ear, \+w then \+w the \+w full \+w grain \+w in \+w the ear. *
\+w But \+w when \+w the \+w fruit \+w is ripe, \+w immediately \+w he puts \+w in \+w the \+w sickle \+w because \+w the \+w harvest \+w has \+w come
He said, “\+w How \+w will \+w we liken \+w God Kingdom? \+w Or \+w with \+w what \+w parable \+w will \+w we illustrate \+w it *

\+w It \+w like \+w a \+w grain \+w of \+w mustard \+w seed \+w which \+w when \+w it \+w is \+w sown \+w in \+w the \+w earth \+w though \+w it \+w is \+w less \+w than \+w all \+w the \+w seeds \+w that \+w are \+w on \+w the \+w earth *

\+w yet \+w when \+w it \+w is \+w sown \+w grows \+w up \+w and \+w becomes \+w greater \+w than \+w all \+w the \+w herbs \+w and \+w puts \+w out \+w great \+w branches \+w so \+w that \+w the \+w birds \+w of \+w the \+w sky \+w can \+w lodge \+w under \+w its \+w shadow
With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “\+w Let \+w go \+w over \+w to \+w the \+w other \+w side
Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.
A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.
He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “\+w Peace \+w Be \+w still The wind ceased and there was a great calm.
He said to them, “\+w Why \+w are \+w you \+w so \+w afraid \+w How \+w is \+w it \+w that \+w you \+w have \+w no \+w faith
They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
